behaviour: C1: votes are stored under the group-scoped key few:poll-votes:{groupId}:{pollId}; every PollVote row carries groupId; loadVotes(groupId, pollId) returns only rows whose groupId and pollId both match. The close tally (pollHandler.handleClose and the chatHandler poll_close gate) reads loadVotes(ctx.groupId, pollId).

C2: legacy few:poll-votes:{pollId} rows (entries without groupId) are migrated once per page session, before the first vote read/write: groupId is recovered from the poll store; a poll present in exactly one group -> rows moved with groupId stamped (an existing group-scoped row with the same id wins); unknown or multi-group poll -> rows dropped; the legacy key is removed. Re-running is a no-op; a crash-replay neither loses nor duplicates rows.

C3: a vote for a poll unknown in this group is queued (IDB key few:poll-pending-votes:{groupId}) with the authenticated sender as voter and the raw responses; latest arrival per (pollId, voter) replaces; at most MAX_PENDING_VOTES_PER_VOTER distinct polls per voter per group (further new ones dropped); at most MAX_PENDING_VOTES_PER_GROUP entries per group (oldest-received evicted); entries older than PENDING_VOTE_TTL_MS are discarded.

C4: on an accepted poll-open, queued votes for (groupId, pollId) are taken (removed) and run through the exact live-vote sanitisation (valid option ids only, single-choice cap to one, all-invalid dropped) before being stored. A vote for a known closed poll is dropped, never queued.

C5: clearPollData(groupId) removes that group's polls, every group-scoped vote key of that group and its pending queue; clearAllPollData removes all poll, vote and pending keys and re-arms the migration.
C6: parsePollOpen rejects options > 10, title > 200, description > 500 or non-string, any option label > 100 (POLL_LIMITS shared with CreatePollModal); parsePollVote rejects more than 10 responses.
C7: AC-9 close-tally sentence corrected to the shipped recompute; docs/behavior/polls.md describes the queue, its bounds, group scoping and receive-side caps.
C8: privacy invariant untouched: no new network publishes; all new state is local IDB.
non_goals: Queueing a poll-close that arrives before its poll-open.
Timestamp arbitration between a voter's votes (arrival order stays).
Gating the poll_open chat announcement on the poll-open caps.
